title: Ravi Kishan reveals wife's hilarious warning amid his viral memes: ‘Thode din shaant rahein varna…’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and Lok Sabha member Ravi Kishan has been going widely shared on social media. Clips such as ‘Jaldi the Late’ and ‘Money follows my brother’ from his recent podcast became memes. Amid all the attention, Ravi revealed how his wife, Preeti Shukla, reacted to the memes about him and his newfound social media popularity.

Adding to this, Ravi Kishan reveals wife's reaction to his memes. Ravi Kishan shares wife's reaction to his memes In a conversation with News18, Ravi opened up that he observed a maun vrat after noticing the memes being made about him. He also lauded Gen Z, saying that their tendency to turn his comments into memes was their way of embracing him. Ravi shared that after realising almost everything he shared was becoming meme material, he decided to remain silent for a while.

Meanwhile, Ravi revealed his wife's reaction to social media memes on him and shared, "Humari patni boli kripya aap thode din shaant rahein varna tumhe ghar hi mein hum lock kardenge. Patni humko boli, ‘Tum ghar se nikalte ho toh widely shared hote ho,’ toh woh baccho ko bol rahi thi ki inko yahi kamre me lock kar dete hai. Na yeh niklenge na yeh widely shared honge (My wife shared, ‘Please stay quiet for a few days, otherwise I’ll lock you up at home.’ My wife told me, ‘Whenever you step out of the house, you go widely shared.’ So she was telling the kids, ‘Let’s just lock him in this room. That way, he won’t step out, and he won’t go widely shared.)”

Notably, Over the past few weeks, old and new clips of the star-politician have been widely shared, edited and turned into memes. Whether it's his dance video or his Kotheshwaray singing act, the star became a favourite among meme-makers. Some of his other widely shared memes include his “Money follows my brother” remark from a podcast with Raj Shamani, his “Jaldi, the late” line, and snippets from his interviews and speeches.

As per the latest buzz, Ravi is awaiting the rollout of his soon-to-release movie, Mirzapur: The Movie. The makers have rolled out the trailer of Mirzapur: The Movie, which continues from the world of Season 1, bringing together some of the franchise's most beloved and iconic characters, including Kaleen Bhaiya, Munna Bhaiya and Guddu Pandit. Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, Divyendu, and Rasika Dugal are all returning. The character of Bablu Pandit, originally played by Vikrant Massey in the series, will be portrayed by Jitendra Kumar in the movie. It is scheduled to rollout in theatres on September 4.

title: ‘Pakistan ke prem mein mare rahte hain’: Kangana Ranaut defends calling Naseeruddin Shah ‘lomdi’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut of late took a sharp jibe at veteran star Naseeruddin Shah over his comments on student protests, referring to him as a “lomdi” (fox). Now, Kangana has defended her remark and hit out at the star over what she described as his “love for Pakistan”, while also accusing the movie industry of “hypocrisy”.

Adding to this, BJP MP Kangana Ranaut calls out movie industry's hypocrisy. (PTI Photo/Shahbaz Khan)(PTI07_21_2026_000081B) (PTI) Kangana Ranaut defends calling Naseeruddin Shah ‘lomdi’ In a conversation with ANI, Kangana criticised what she described as the movie industry’s “consistent attitude”, recalling the unrest surrounding protests at Jantar Mantar. She claimed that during the protests, several of her parliamentarian friends had people climbing onto their cars and breaking their windows, while around 2,500 people had gathered outside her home, prompting a heavy police presence that kept her family awake at night.

Meanwhile, She added, “So when a situation like this was unfolding at Jantar Mantar, they were all shedding crocodile tears. But now that children in Jharkhand are facing this kind of oppression, aren’t they Gen Z too? Is someone only considered Gen Z if they act against the country or abuse the Prime Minister? They themselves have been made to appear anti-youth. This hypocrisy in the movie industry will not work. The crocodile tears that people from the movie industry were shedding for Jantar Mantar, they should shed the same tears for the children in Jharkhand as well.”

Notably, She then defended her “lomdi” remark about Naseeruddin Shah, saying, “I shared this about Naseeruddin Shah because he had made such a distasteful video in which he was making threats of this kind. And whenever you look at his films, interviews or statements, it is always about Pakistan. Yeh Pakistan ki prem katha kab khatam hogi? Jab dekho Pakistan ke prem mein yeh mare rahte hain. Ab Partition ko bhi itne saal ho gaye hain toh yeh love story khatam kyun nahi ho rahi hai (When will this love story with Pakistan end? He is always obsessed with his love for Pakistan. So many years have passed since Partition, so why hasn’t this love story ended yet?).”

As per the latest buzz, Last week, taking to her Instagram Stories, Kangana reposted a comment by star Piyush Mishra on Naseeruddin’s remarks, in which he questioned the veteran star’s silence on the student protests in Jharkhand. She added a separate note that read, “Sach toh ye hai ki har koi kisi na kisi ka kutta hai lekin mujhe iss baat ka garv hai ki main jiss ghar (desh) ki roti khati hoon uski rakhwaali karti hoon, uske liye ladti hoon. Naseer saab khate toh iss desh ke hain lekin ladte padosi desh ke liye hai (The truth is that each and everyone of us is someone’s pet. I am proud that I protect and defend the same house from where I get my food. But Naseer saab eats from this land and defends the neighbouring country).”
In further updates, She added, “PS: In today’s time it is a compliment to be called a dog because loyalty and cuteness is so rare. I would rather be a dog than a lomdi (fox) like Naseeruddin.”

title: Shriya Saran says she wasn’t invited to award shows despite nominations after Awarapan's failure: ‘I was disheartened’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Mohit Suri ’s 2007 movie Awarapan, starring Emraan Hashmi , Shriya Saran and Mrinalini Sharma, underperformed at the ticket-window upon rollout but eventually developed a cult following. Now, almost two decades later, its sequel is set to hit theatres. In an interview with Pinkvilla, Shriya recalled being disheartened by the movie’s initial ticket-window performance and opened up that she was not even invited to some award shows despite the movie receiving nominations.

Adding to this, Shriya Saran recalls being disheartened after Awarapan flopped. Shriya Saran on Awarapan's failure Shriya shared, “When the movie came out, we all had lots of hopes for it. But I don’t know why; I think it was ahead of its time. It was even nominated in some award shows, and they didn’t send me an invite. It was like that. And Awarapan is a movie which I felt would be celebrated; people would love it. So when something like that happens, you kind of feel very disheartened.”

Meanwhile, The star also reflected on the movie’s enduring popularity, noting that audiences continued to tell her how much they loved it despite its initial ticket-window performance. She added, “So then, for the longest time, I thought maybe it was the songs they loved, because the songs were amazing and Emraan was amazing. But now, you know, I feel like people loved the story. They kind of felt it. Because it’s a very intense, intense story. So people really felt it. Otherwise, the amount of love they’re still giving it, the amount they’re giving to it even now, it wouldn’t be like that. It wouldn’t be.”

Notably, Awarapan is a 2007 Hindi romantic action drama directed by Mohit Suri and produced by Mahesh Bhatt and Mukesh Bhatt. Starring Emraan Hashmi, Mrinalini Sharma and Shriya Saran, the movie follows Shivam Pandit, a troubled gangster whose life begins to change when he is asked to keep watch over a Pakistani woman, Aaliyah. Although Awarapan did not perform strongly at the ticket-window upon rollout, it developed a loyal following over the years. Its music, particularly songs such as Toh Phir Aao, Tera Mera Rishta and Mahiya, became popular and contributed to the movie’s lasting appeal.

As per the latest buzz, Almost two decades later, the movie’s sequel is set to rollout in theatres. Directed by Nitin Kakkar, Awarapan 2 stars Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani and Shabana Azmi in lead roles. The movie is scheduled to rollout in theatres on August 14 and will clash with Sunny Deol’s Batwara 1947.

title: Karnataka bandh LIVE updates: Bengaluru's Kempegowda International Airport remains operational amid statewide shutdown
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Karnataka bandh LIVE updates: Security has been beefed up across various parts of Karnataka, including Bengaluru, in view of the bandh call. Karnataka bandh LIVE updates: Schools, banks, hospitals, pharmacies, public transport will operate normally in Karnataka today amid the bandh call given by several Kanada organisations over the Cauvery water-sharing row. Meanwhile, the Bengaluru City Police have appealed for calm and cooperation ahead of the 'Karnataka Bandh' called for August 13, 2026, in protest against the Cauvery Water Management Authority's order on Cauvery water allocation to Tamil Nadu. ...Read More

Adding to this, In a press note issued, the Commissioner of Police shared several organisations have called for the bandh, while other organisations have informed police that they are not supporting it. The Bengaluru City Police shared that they fully respect citizens' democratic right to protest peacefully within the law. At the same time, police shared it is equally important to respect the right of other citizens to carry out daily activities without obstruction. "All organisations and members of the public are requested to cooperate with the Bengaluru City Police in maintaining peace, public order and normalcy in the city," the note shared. What is open, what is closed amid shutdown call? Schools, banks and hospitals will function per normal. Public transport will also remain unaffected as Bangalore Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC) and Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) employees' association have not provided support to the bandh. So are the private bus associations, transporters and autorickshaw associations, who have distanced themselves from the bandh. Similarly, street vendors will also function as usual because everyone is only extending moral support. Farmers, Kanada organisations oppose Cauvery water-sharing Sporadic protests by farmers and Kannada organisations in Karnataka broke out against the Cauvery Water Management Authority (CWMA) order directing the state to rollout 12,000 cusecs of water daily to Tamil Nadu for 15 days from August 12. Farmer organisations staged demonstration in Mandya, while various Kannada organisations gave a call for a Karnataka Bandh on August 13 in protest against the order. The CWMA has directed Karnataka to comply with the decision of the Cauvery Water Regulation Committee (CWRC) to rollout 12,000 cusecs daily for 15 days, with the water to be realised at Biligundlu.

Meanwhile, Karnataka bandh LIVE updates: While several Kanada and farmer organisations have called for a statewide bandh, the shutdown is unlikely to impact normal life. Schools, banks and hospitals will remain open. Public transport will also ply on roads as normal as Bangalore Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC) and Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) employees' association have not provided support to the bandh. So are the private bus associations, transporters and autorickshaw associations, who have distanced themselves from the bandh.

Notably, Karnataka bandh LIVE updates: Kanada leader Lokesh Gowda shared that Cauvery water should not be rolled out to Tamil Nadu, citing water shortage in Karnataka. “Under no circumstances should Cauvery water be rolled out to Tamil Nadu as we ourselves do not have enough water,” Gowda told ANI.

As per the latest buzz, Karnataka bandh LIVE updates: In Mysuru, the nationwide bandh largely remained confined to protests. Bus services from the suburban bus stand to Bengaluru, Mangaluru and other parts of the state were operated normally.
In further updates, Police detained pro-Kannada activists who attempted to block buses near the suburban bus stand.
On top of that, Karnataka bandh LIVE updates: Bengaluru City Police appealed for calm and cooperation as various organisation take part in ‘Karnataka Bandh’.

In a press note, the police shared that they fully respect citizens' democratic right to protest peacefully within the law, but called on protestors to respect the right of other citizens to carry out daily activities without obstruction.

title: Exclusive | Suvinder Vicky recalls abusing Arjun Rampal in Dhurandhar 2: ‘Will not go to mothers, sisters’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The audience took notice of Suvinder Vicky after he played the unforgettable character of policeman Balbir Singh in Kohrra . Since then, he has taken on some challenging character roles across films and web series. However, his recent projects, Satluj and Dhurandhar 2 , have placed him in two very different cinematic worlds, with the former facing a rollout ban and the latter emerging as a major smash hit.

Adding to this, Suvinder Vicky and Arjun Rampal in stills from Dhurandhar 2. In an exclusive conversation with Hindustan Times, Suvinder opened up about his contrasting roles, the depiction of violence on screen, and the responsibility of actors and filmmakers while portraying sensitive events.

Meanwhile, I am lucky that I got to star in both films. Even though my character was small and I had to abuse a lot in Dhurandhar 2, but people showered me with a lot of love. I never became a meme before, but after Dhurandhar, a lot of memes were made on my character, so I was on a high.

Notably, I am playing a negative character in Satluj, and I thought that after people see me in the movie, mujhe bahut galiyan padegi (Audience will abuse me), but those who have seen that era understand it.

As per the latest buzz, Many people might question why I do characters like this, but today's audience is smart, and they can differentiate between reel and real. But if actors did not play these characters as authentically as possible, many would not feel the fear of that time. Even if I talk about my kids, they don’t know what happened in 1984, and they don’t know who Jaswant Kalra was. So, maybe it is us actors and directors who are responsible for showing it as authentically as possible.

In further updates, We are hearing that the movie's pirated version is available. We don't support piracy, but a movie reaches the audience some way or the other. Definitely, if this movie was rolled out on 70 MM, the makers would have got their return on investment, and it would be nice to watch it on the big screen.

On top of that, There are films which are based on real life and then there are fictional films, but they are also inspired by what goes on in the society. Hum hi insaan hai, hum hi shaitan hai. It depends who takes what in what sense. It depends on your thinking and also it is your choice. Now we have options. Earlier, we only had theatres and Doordarshan. Now, we are moving with entertainment in our hands, if we don’t like something, we can go to something else. Also, it looks real on screen because everybody has done justice to their work in the movie.

I’m lucky to work with great directors. In this, the credit goes to Aditya Dhar and to me also because I also gave my hundred percent effort. Also, galiyon ka shrey hamare script writer ko bhi jayega (The credit for all the abusive language would also go our screenwriter), because I didn’t make any of those, that was all written in the script.

title: ‘Cockroaches emerge from gutters, what is wrong with that?’: Kangana Ranaut defends her gutter generation remark
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut stirred row after she shared that some young Hindu women flaunt freedom without accountability and called them ‘ generation gutter ’. After backlash over her comments, Kangana has now clarified on her comments to news agency ANI.

Adding to this, BJP MP Kangana Ranaut at the Parliament Premises during the Monsoon Session. (ANI Photo/Rahul Singh) (Rahul Singh) What Kangana shared Kangana shared she had not made a blanket statement about the protest at Jantar Mantar over the NEET-UG paper leak and she "specifically referred to some people or some women".

Meanwhile, "Those who call themselves cockroaches, and we say that cockroaches emerge from gutters, what is wrong with that? My point is simply this: if people label themselves as cockroaches, and we say the gutter is their home, why should they be offended? I certainly don't consider myself a cockroach. If someone were to say I live in a gutter, I would deny it. But if someone claims to be a cockroach, then naturally, they would live in a gutter. Where else? But to claim that I was referring to all youth is simply not the case," she shared.

Notably, "If some young people use drugs, or if we discuss the current trend of addiction involving drugs, betting, gambling, or the dark web, addressing a specific segment of the youth doesn't mean I was making a blanket statement about everyone. Did I say that all youth belong to the gutter? I specifically referred to some people or some women. So, how else should we address this?" she asked.

As per the latest buzz, Earlier, Kangana had criticized the Gen Z protests. Kangana wrote, "Never in my life have I seen so much ugliness in one place. These reels from Gen Z protests are puke-inducing. The way they speak and the kind of language they are using... never in my life have I seen everything in each and every frame so jarring and so crass all at once....I call them Generation Gutter. Some of them have nothing to offer to the system. They are not good at studies...," she had shared.

In further updates, “You call yourself cockroaches and look/behave like them as well... there is no paradox or juxtaposition there, just simply subjecting the world to your filth, garbage and ugliness. I am scarred from these reels, need some healing, digital detox,” the star had shared. Her remarks came after Delhi Police directed multiple social media platforms to remove posts and videos containing offensive and abusive remarks. The posts were allegedly uploaded during the student protests at Jantar Mantar after the police crackdown during the July 20 Chalo Sansad march.

On top of that, On the work front, Kangana Ranaut was last seen in the movie Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata . Directed by Manoj Tapadia, the movie was based on the true story of the nurses and staff at Cama Hospital who saved the lives of patients during the 2008 Mumbai terrorist attacks. It will stream on Zee5 from August 14.

title: J'khand: Raghubar Das threatens hunger strike if CBI probe into exam irregularities not recommended
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Former Jharkhand chief minister Raghubar Das on Wednesday threatened to sit on a hunger strike if the JMM-led dispensation failed to recommend a CBI probe into alleged recruitment examination irregularities in the state within a week.

Adding to this, Raghubar Das alleged that massive recruitment scams took place in the last six years under the JMM-led regime. (PTI) Thousands of students in Jharkhand have been agitating over alleged irregularities in recruitment examinations in the state for the past 19 days under the banner of the ' JPSC -JSSC Reforms Manch'.

Meanwhile, "If the state government fails to recommend a CBI probe into recruitment examination irregularities within a week, I will be forced to sit on a hunger strike here," Das, who was also the governor of Odisha, shared while addressing agitating students at Jaipal Singh Munda Stadium.
Notably, The BJP leader accused JMM-led government of playing with the fate of lakhs of students in the state.

As per the latest buzz, "If the government is clean and has no involvement, it should recommend CBI probe into the irregularities. Otherwise, people of Jharkhand will consider there is involvement of top politicians and bureaucrats in the irregularities," he shared.
In further updates, Das alleged that massive recruitment scams took place in the last six years under the JMM-led regime.
On top of that, He also demanded ₹ 1 crore rupees compensation each for the next of kin of 19 people who died during physical tests for excise constable recruitment in 2024.

title: Anup Soni REACTS to Ajay Devgn replacing him as Crime Patrol host: “I am sure he will bring his own style and perspective”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Anup Soni reacts to Ajay Devgn replacing him as Crime Patrol host, saying he is a fan of the star and wishing the new season’s team well.

Adding to this, In conversation with Variety India, Soni shared he remains grateful for his association with the franchise and the response he received from viewers over the years. “I don’t have much to say on this. I have had a long and very special association with Crime Patrol, and I am grateful for all the love and affection the audience has given me over the years,” he shared.

Meanwhile, Soni hosted Crime Patrol between 2010 and 2021 and became one of the most recognisable faces of the franchise. The series originally premiered in 2003 and went on to run for multiple seasons and more than 2,000 episodes, establishing itself as one of Indian television's longest-running crime-based programmes.

Notably, Devgn's entry marks a significant change for the franchise as the soon-to-release season, titled Crime Patrol 2026: Crime Ka Current Season, is set to return with a revamped presentation. The star has already shot 15 episodes of the new season, which is scheduled to premiere on August 31.

As per the latest buzz, Reacting to the change in hosting, Soni spoke warmly about Devgn and recalled his previous professional association with the star. “I am a big fan of Ajay Devgn and have also had the opportunity to share the screen with him in films like Prakash Jha’s Gangaajal and Apaharan . I am sure he will bring his own style and perspective to the show. I wish the team all the very best for the new season,” he shared.

In further updates, While Devgn begins a new chapter with the franchise, Soni is also looking ahead to his soon-to-release work. He opened up that he has a web series and a movie lined up for rollout next month. “I have a web series and a movie releasing next month, and they’re very different roles. I am hoping the audience will give me the same love and affection in these projects as they did in Crime Patrol,” Soni concluded.

title: Army veteran calls out alleged Tricolour error in Operation Safed Sagar scene, seeks apology from makers and Netflix: “I am shocked”
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:
Army veteran Colonel Vembu Shankar flags alleged Tricolour placement error on Ajay Ahuja’s coffin in Operation Safed Sagar and calls for an apology.

Adding to this, Shankar shared a screengrab from the show on Instagram, pointing to a sequence in which Siddharth, who portrays Squadron Leader Ajay Ahuja, is represented through the coffin carried by characters played by Mihir Ahuja and Abhay Verma. Mihir portrays Flying Officer C.H. Bal Reddy, also known as Baldy, while Abhay plays Flying Officer Rajpal Singh Dhaliwal, known as Dhali.

Meanwhile, According to the Army veteran, the Tricolour covering Ahuja's coffin in the scene has not been positioned in accordance with the Flag Code of India. He questioned how the alleged error made it through the production process despite the involvement of military advisers and the relevant authorities. “I am shocked how the authorities at the Service Headquarters and the military advisors have overlooked this fact,” Shankar shared.
Notably, A post shared by Vembu Shankar (@vembushankar)
As per the latest buzz, The veteran also called upon the makers and those responsible for the scene to acknowledge the alleged error and issue an apology through mainstream media.

In further updates, The concern comes in the context of the real-life story of Squadron Leader Ajay Ahuja, an Indian Air Force officer who was killed during the Kargil War in 1999. Ahuja was part of the Indian Air Force's operations during the conflict and was posthumously awarded the Vir Chakra for his service.

On top of that, Operation Safed Sagar explores the Indian Air Force's role during the Kargil War and focuses on Operation Safed Sagar, the high-altitude air operation carried out during the conflict. The series brings the experiences of military personnel involved in the operation to the screen and features an ensemble cast including Jimmy Shergill, Siddharth, Vinay Pathak, Manu Rishi Chadha, Abhay Verma, Arnav Bhasin, Adil Hussain, Sanjay Suri, Barun Sobti, Dia Mirza and Prajakta Koli, among others.

As of now, the makers of Operation Safed Sagar have not issued a response to Shankar's concerns or his call for an apology. The allegation regarding the flag placement remains his shared objection to the scene.

title: Delhi HC protects Khushi Kapoor’s personality rights, orders takedown of allegedly obscene content
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Delhi HC orders removal of allegedly obscene content and unauthorised merchandise featuring Khushi Kapoor, while considering a John Doe order for her protection.

Adding to this, A John Doe order is a legal mechanism that allows protection to be extended to unidentified individuals or entities who may subsequently be found to be involved in the unauthorised use or exploitation of a person's identity. The order can therefore help a public figure seek action against unknown parties involved in such misuse.
Meanwhile, Khushi Kapoor was represented before the Delhi High Court by India Law through its partners Asav Rajan and Abha Shah.

Notably, The court's directions come amid increasing legal scrutiny of the unauthorised use of celebrities' names, photographs, voices, likenesses and other identifiable personality traits. Public figures have increasingly approached courts over the commercial exploitation of their identities, particularly in connection with digital content, merchandise and emerging technologies.

As per the latest buzz, The Khushi Kapoor case also comes a day after a coordinate bench of the Delhi High Court issued similar takedown directions concerning allegedly objectionable content and unauthorised exploitation of the personality rights of her sister, star Janhvi Kapoor.

In further updates, In recent years, personality rights have emerged as an important area of litigation involving actors and other public figures. Courts have considered distinctive attributes such as a person's name, image, voice and likeness as elements that can receive legal protection against unauthorised use, particularly when such use has implications for commercial interests, reputation, privacy or dignity.

On top of that, The latest order concerning Khushi Kapoor adds to this growing body of proceedings before the Delhi High Court. The directions seek to address both the circulation of allegedly objectionable material and the commercial use of the star's personality attributes without authorisation.

As the court considers the interim injunction plea and the proposed John Doe order, the case could further underline the importance of legal protection for celebrities dealing with unauthorised digital exploitation of their identities.

title: Khushi Kapoor receives relief in Delhi HC against obscene and pornographic content after sister Janhvi Kapoor
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Khushi Kapoor received relief from the Delhi High Court on Wednesday after her sister, star Janhvi Kapoor , approached the court in a similar case. The court has directed the removal of alleged obscene and pornographic content of Khushi from social media platforms, and has also ordered the takedown of content impugning her personality rights.

Adding to this, Khushi Kapoor appoached the Delhi High Court to protect her personality rights. Khushi Kapoor receives relief from Delhi HC According to ANI, Justice Jyoti Singh passed the directions while hearing Khushi ’s suit seeking protection of her personality and publicity rights. The court indicated that it would pass a John Doe order in her favour in connection with her interim injunction plea. The order would provide protection against unidentified persons who are involved in the unauthorised use or exploitation of her identity. The HC directed the removal of alleged obscene and pornographic content of Khushi, and the takedown of content linked to the unauthorised sale of merchandise using her personality.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Janhvi Kapoor (@janhvikapoor)

Notably, Just a day before this, on Tuesday, Janhvi had also received relief from the HC in a similar case. The court had passed a similar takedown direction on objectionable content and unauthorised exploitation of the star’s personality. The court, however, refused to give a blanket injunction against fan pages. Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani heard the case and disagreed with the demand to remove fan pages. The court shared that fan sites can vary widely; some may praise an star's work, while others may criticise it. “You don't want followers? It is the digital world. No comments, no URLs...You will find yourself living in a cave,” shared the court.

As per the latest buzz, The Delhi HC has seen an increase in cases involving the unauthorised usage of celebrities’ names, photographs, voices, likeness and personality attributes. Such cases have included not only merchandise and digital content but also AI-generated content. Amitabh Bachchan, Aishwarya Rai, Abhishek Bachchan, Salman Khan, Karan Johar, Hrithik Roshan, Tabu, Jr NTR, Allu Arjun, Nagarjuna, and R Madhavan are among the celebrities who have approached the court to protect their personality rights.

title: Scam 2010 begins production: Hansal Mehta to direct Siddharth Bodke in new chapter
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Speaking about the series, Hansal Mehta shared, “Scam 2010 is a story about ambition, influence and the arrogance that follows both. It looks at how one of India’s largest business empires was built on belief — and what happened when that belief ran out. It tells the fascinating story of the rise of an empire and the man who mistook it for invincibility.”

Adding to this, Deepak Segal, Chief Content Officer, Applause Entertainment, shared, "Scam has become much more than a franchise for us. The success of Scam comes with a lot of responsibility, as we are extremely conscious of the expectations that people have from us. Scam 1992 arrived at a time when the Indian streaming ecosystem was still finding its voice and went on to become one of the most loved and culturally resonant series to emerge from India. The success of Scam 1992 gave us the confidence to build an anthology around a simple but powerful idea: India’s history is full of extraordinary stories in which ambition, money, power, and human nature collide. With Scam 2010, we are taking that ambition even further. What makes this season particularly exciting is having Hansal Mehta return to direct. Hansal has been integral to the DNA of Scam from the beginning, and his ability to transform complex real-life events into intimate, gripping human stories is one of the reasons the franchise has resonated so deeply."

Meanwhile, Siddharth Bodke, who steps into the lead role, shared, "What floored me was the complexity of the lead’s personality and the scale of the show. His passion, power, flaws, rise and eventual downfall make him an incredibly fascinating character to portray. The experience has been nothing short of thrilling for me, and I have relished the opportunity to play such a layered character under the guidance of someone like Hansal Mehta.”
Notably, Produced by Birla Studios and Applause Entertainment, Scam 2010 is currently in production and will stream exclusively on Sony LIV soon.

title: Vir Das completes Baara Number shoot; calls found-footage psychological thriller an "incredibly intense" experience
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Co-produced by Naresh Malik along with Jeff Lazarus and Kaushik Srinivasan from Third Frame Studio, Kavita Gupta and Vir Das’ Zazu Productions with Kavi Shastri as the creative producer on board, Baara Number brings together an accomplished ensemble cast featuring Sheeba Chaddha, Suhail Nayyar, Arunoday Singh, Ahsaas Channa, Atul Kulkarni, Niharika Lyra Dutt, Shriya Pilgaonkar, Puja Sarup, Navin Kaushik amongst others.

Adding to this, The movie’s found-footage format forms an integral part of its storytelling, allowing the narrative to unfold through a deeply immersive visual language while exploring the psychological dimensions of its characters. The project marks an ambitious step for Das as he continues to explore stories and filmmaking styles beyond conventional formats.

Meanwhile, Speaking about wrapping up the movie, Vir Das shared, “ Baara Number has been an incredibly intense and rewarding experience for me because it challenged me in almost every way possible. Making a psychological thriller is already a very specific exercise in restraint, atmosphere and character, but choosing to tell it through the found-footage format added an entirely different layer to the process. You don't have the luxury of conventional filmmaking language in the same way. The camera itself becomes part of the world, and the audience has to feel like they are discovering the story rather than simply watching it unfold. That was both exciting and terrifying. There were days when we were constantly questioning whether we were pushing the format enough, whether the performances felt organic enough, and whether the audience would feel that sense of unease and intimacy that the story demands."

Notably, He further added, "What makes Baara Number particularly special to me is the ensemble we have put together. Every star came into this project with such a strong understanding of their craft, but more importantly, they were willing to experiment. When you are working on a psychological thriller, especially one that relies so heavily on performance and atmosphere, you need actors who are willing to trust the material and embrace uncertainty. They did exactly that. As a producer, it has also been incredibly fulfilling to create a space where everyone could take those creative risks. Zazu Productions has always been about telling stories that feel different and giving filmmakers and performers the freedom to experiment, and Baara Number feels very much like an extension of that philosophy."

As per the latest buzz, He continued, "Wrapping the shoot is a strange feeling because after living with these characters and this world for so long, suddenly you have to let them go. But there is also a tremendous sense of excitement because now the movie gets to find its final form in the edit and post-production. I think audiences are going to experience Baara Number in a way that is quite different from a conventional psychological thriller. We have tried to create something that feels immediate, unpredictable and deeply immersive, while still being driven by character. For me, this movie represents another step in my journey as a filmmaker. My first movie taught me so much about finding my voice behind the camera, and Baara Number has pushed me to question that voice, experiment with it and take it somewhere new. I can't wait for audiences to see what we've created."

In further updates, With Baara Number , Vir Das continues to expand his filmmaking journey, taking on a challenging genre and an unconventional storytelling format while bringing together a strong ensemble of performers. The movie is expected to offer audiences a tense and immersive psychological experience, with the found-footage approach placing them directly inside the unfolding narrative.

title: Exclusive | Vipin Sharma on his film Kamathipura Express winning Student Academy Awards: We are now in the Oscars race
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Vipin Sharma has added a feather in his cap after his short movie Kamathipura Express , directed by Leon Korzynsky from Warsaw Movie School, Poland , won the silver medal at the Student Academy Awards , revealed last week.

Adding to this, Star Vipin Sharma plays antagonist in Polish movie Kamathipura Express. (Inset) Stills from the movie Organised by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences and the ceremony for the same will be held as part of the Toronto International Movie Festival (TIFF) in Canada next month.
Meanwhile, Last seen in Dhadak 2 (2025), the star plays the antagonist in the movie that has been shot in India.

Notably, The star tells HT City, “It stands at a very great place as it’s after all an Oscar. It won the silver medal in the Student Academy Awards out of 2,972 entries from 894 colleges and universities worldwide. The movie stars Polish boy Oskar Karos and Mia Paul, who plays my daughter.”

As per the latest buzz, Sharma says that now the movie will be competing for the Oscars in the Best Short Movie category. “The Gold, Silver and Bronze awardees get a direct entry as a nomination for the Academy Awards to be held in LA in March 2027. Some of the very big filmmakers today have won this award as a student.”

In further updates, The movie was shot in September 2025. “This opens the door for more young filmmakers to come and shoot in India. For young directors it’s a dream to make a movie in India. Leon was very fascinated with Slumdog Millionaire (2008). He conceived the movie and made it independently.”

On top of that, Sharma says there was a lot to learn from young students. “The director is barely 24 but as an star I just surrender to my director. These youngsters bring so much energy and passion to make a movie,” he says and gives an example, “We were shooting at a beach in the coastal area, and the cops were not allowing us to shoot. I saw they were in tears and touching the feet of cops and literally begging to allow them. Such is their passion and attachment to their movie.”
The movie was shot in the slums of Mumbai and near Bengaluru as well.

title: From 2016 to 2026: Here's how Bollywood films fared on every Independence Day weekend in the last 10 years
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Independence Day weekend, historically, has been one reserved for big, tentpole films. As Sunny Deol's Batwara 1947 gears up for a clash with Emraan Hashmi's Awarapan 2 this year, here's a lowdown on how the lucrative rollout window has fared for Hindi films in the last 10 years
Adding to this, Stills from Stree 2, Gadar 2, Mission Mangal. (all figures all India collections) :

Meanwhile, It was termed a battle of the titans, as Akshay Kumar and Hrithik Roshan both were ready with their films in the weekend leading up to Independence Day. Akshay’s movie was based on the sensational, real-life Nanavati case, while Hrithik’s was a love story set in the times of the Mohenjodaro civilisation. Akshay won, with Rustom garnering not just ₹ 127 crores in ticket sales in India, but also fetching him a National Award for Best Star. Mohenjodaro, on the other hand, collected ₹ 58 crores (all-India) and sealed its fate.

Notably, Akshay Kumar was truly on a golden streak back then, with back to back hit films to his credit. Amidst this came Toilet: Ek Prem Katha, emphasising on the need for better sanitation measures in the country. Directed by Shree Narayan Singh, the movie was a big success, collecting ₹ 134 crores across India. It was even lauded by the likes of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and billionaire businessman & philanthropist Bill Gates.

As per the latest buzz, The National Holiday saw two films, both possessing patriotic flavor, locking horns. John Abraham and Manoj Bajpayee faced off against each other in Satyameva Jayate, while off screen it was John versus Akshay Kumar’s Gold. The latter was a sports drama, based on India’s national hockey team’s journey to the 1948 Summer Olympics. SJ collected ₹ 80 crores, and Gold collected ₹ 104 crores, both ultimately managing to attract ample audiences to the theatres.

In further updates, Akshay vs John, second year in a row! 2019 was a repeat of 2018, as the two stars decided to rollout their films on the same Independence Day weekend. This time, both their films had a real-life connect. Mission Mangal, a multi-starrer, was about India’s first interplanetary expedition, the Mars Orbiter Mission, while Batla House was based on the 2008 encounter at Batla House in Mumbai. Both films worked, with Akshay’s movie earning ₹ 203 crores, and John’s movie collecting ₹ 87 crores.

On top of that, This year, the Covid pandemic affected life everywhere. With movie theatres shut down, it was left to OTT to entertain people within their homes. Vidyut Jammwal’s Khuda Haafiz rolled out on JioHotstar (then Disney+ Hotstar).

2022 saw people returning to theatres, but the weekend leading up to Independence Day was a let down. Two superstars rolled out their films alongside, yet none found enough takers. Aamir Khan’s Laal Singh Chaddha, affected by the negativity preceding its rollout, only managed to collect close to ₹ 59 crores. Akshay’s Raksha Bandhan, a heartfelt story about the bond between a brother and his sisters, collected ₹ 45 crores.

title: Baby Do Die Do actor Rachit Singh is pro PR machinery but not without strong hold on acting
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Rachit Singh is two films old in the industry but his decade long experience as an acting coach gives him the leverage to prioritize how he wants to take his career ahead. So, while actors swear by a strong PR machinery in today’s time, Rachit feels everything becomes incomplete if an artist doesn’t ace their acting prowess.

Adding to this, Rachit Singh was of late seen in Baby Do Die Do Of late seen in Baby Do Die Do as Huma Qureshi’ s love interest, the 36-yer-old star weighs in on the importance of PR and says, “I think today everything is important but first knowing your craft is important. You need to know how to act is important. Everything comes after that. Besides this you need to work hard, you need to be nice person and then eventually also have a PR so that you reach to people.”
Meanwhile, While the debate on organic promotion and PR amplification goes around the movie industry, Rachit doesn’t see an downside on promoting one’s films with help of an external team.

Notably, “Agar aapne product banaya aur wo duniya tak pohoch hi nahi raha to kya fayeda. Ofcourse aapke hard work se aap pohoch sakte ho jo hota hai but shayad PR se aap thoda aur pohoch sakte ho. Humne ek movie banayi aur Baby Do Die Do par bohot logo tak movie pohochi hi nahi to marketing to karni padegi na. Isme koi galat baat thodi hai, isme koi jhoot thodi hai. Humne ek movie banayi jo kisi state mein nahi pohochi to humara kaam hai ki hum usko waha pohchaye,” says the star who made his acting debut with Thamma.

As per the latest buzz, As he builds his career as an star, he has also been a teacher to many youngsters who come to train under him. With dreams of acting in his heart, Rachit gets candid about why Mumbai, the city of dreams never intimidated him when he moved here from Banaras a decade back to become an star.

In further updates, “I always knew that this is a new city and there is competition. Nobody told me to come and become and star. This was my dream and I decided to become an star and I knew there will be challenges. No field is easy. I came from that mindset that I don’t know when the big break will happen and until that happens I will keep my head down and just keep working hard. Any artist who is coming to Mumbai should have in mind to work very hard, be good to people and have a lot of patience,” he concludes.

title: Celina Jaitly says she had to defend weightlifting in ‘bizarre’ divorce proceedings: ‘Used against me as self obsession’
body: Here's the latest relationship update doing the rounds:

Star Celina Jaitly has been through an ordeal in her personal life lately. Amidst her divorce and alleged domestic abuse case against her husband, Peter Haag, separation from her three children, and her brother being detained in the UAE, she has been vocal about it on her social media. In her latest post on Instagram, Celina shared that she was questioned in court for spending around 1.5 hours a day working out.

Adding to this, Celina Jaitly shared her gym sessions were questioned in court during her divorce. What Celina shared Celina shared a picture of herself taken in the gym and wrote a long post detailing how she sees exercise and discipline have helped her through some of the most difficult periods of her life. She began, “Imagine having to defend weightlifting in court. Of all the things filed against me in my bizarre divorce proceedings, perhaps the most incomprehensible was having to answer for the fact that I spent one to 1 hour a day working out. Honestly, through some of the hardest chapters of my life, working out has been one of the few things that has consistently stood by me.”

Meanwhile, She added, “My body has given birth to 2 sets of twins. It has been shook from, loss of a child, the loss of both my parents, twin #csection , dance injuries, the crisis that has befallen my family, trauma surrounding my brother, & now the unimaginable heartbreak of separation from my children.”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Celina Jaitly (@celinajaitlyofficial)

As per the latest buzz, Celina shared how showing up at the gym gave her a space to put the grief, anger, fear and anxiety in rebuilding herself when life kept trying to break her down. “After everything that life demanded of me, somehow that 1.5 hr of lifting weights became something I had to answer for in a COURT. I never thought I would need to be answerable for a value my Fauji father instilled in me from the day I was born. Discipline. Because showing up for yourself every day, whether through a sport, a workout or gym, equals discipline. Discipline equals accountability. & that becomes the example you set, specifically for your children. So amidst everything happening in my life, I still find myself asking, Was it really wrong for me to lift weights for one & a half hours a day? Or was lifting those weights precisely what gave me the strength to carry everything else? The weight on the barbell was never the heaviest weight I carried. It was simply the one weight I could choose to put down.”

In further updates, Celina married Austrian national Peter Haag , and their twins were born in 2012. She gave birth to a second set of twins in 2017, but one of them died due to a health issue. In 2025, the star filed a case under the Domestic Violence Act in a Mumbai court, alleging domestic violence from her husband.

On top of that, The Mumbai police registered an FIR against Peter under multiple sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. A Lookout Circular (LOC) was also issued against him for alleged non-cooperation in the investigation. According to ANI, the case against him pertains to allegations of cruelty, physical harm, criminal intimidation and sustained harassment. The FIR was registered at Versova Police Station on the basis of a complaint by Celina.

title: Mahabharat's Gajendra Chauhan ‘not impressed’ by Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana trailer but praises Arun Govil as Dashrath
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Gajendra Chauhan , who rose to fame playing Yudhishthir in BR Chopra’s Mahabharat series, has expressed his honest opinion about the much-awaited Ramayana movie directed by Nitesh Tiwari. Although he found Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama impressive, the star admitted that the trailer did not do much to convince him entirely. He even pointed some aspects of the movie, particularly that of Kaikeyi, which could have been different.

Adding to this, Gajendra Chauhan says Ramayana trailer failed to impress, questions Lara Dutta’s Kaikeyi. Gajendra Chauhan questions Kaikeyi’s portrayal In an episode of Hindi Rush Podcast, Gajendra admitted that one of the issues was that of Lara Dutta’s representation of Kaikeyi especially her part in asking King Dashrath to banish Ram from his kingdom. He claimed that the styling and representation of this character were not in line with what is traditionally expected of it. “I saw the Ramayana trailer. Personally, I am telling you, I was not impressed. I was not impressed by Kaikeyi's scene where she asks for Ram's exile. Her dressing, for one, is very modern. They have given her a modern saree,” Chauhan shared.

Meanwhile, He himself had an experience of working in Ravi Chopra’s Ramayan of 2002, when he acted as Dashrath. It was treated as a crucial emotional moment, with considerable time spent getting the scene right. This scene was considered the turning point of the family since it starts falling apart after the influence of Manthara on Kaikeyi.

Notably, Despite his concerns about the casting, Gajendra did not dismiss Ranbir Kapoor’s appearance as Lord Rama. In fact, he felt the star looked convincing in the visual glimpses shown in the trailer. “Here, Ranbir Kapoor has his own image. He is a very big star. Now he is playing Ram. He is looking good, no doubt. He looks very good in the get-up,” he noted.

As per the latest buzz, He mentioned the fact that there is an established mental image of Lord Rama that is deeply entrenched within the minds of people due to culture and previous screen versions of this character. Hence, it becomes extremely difficult for any other star to fully meet the expectations of the audience.

In further updates, He shared that people generally form an image of the god with very particular royal features like a prominent nose and a kingly aura. Even when people have these pre-established notions about this character, here refrained from criticising the casting of Ranbir Kapoor based on teaser clips alone. He believed that one could judge his performance only after watching the entire movie.

On top of that, Despite the fact that there were sections in the trailer where Gajendra wasn't very sure of, one thing which Gajendra really appreciated was the casting of Arun Govil as King Dashrath. Arun Govil had the credit of playing Lord Ram in the TV series Ramayan, directed by Ramanand Sagar, during the late 1980s. “I think the best casting is Arun Govil as Dashrath. He was Ram 40 years ago. After 40 years, he has grown into Dashrath. He has become a father. I think that is very good casting for Ramayana. He is looking good too,” he added.

He went on to assert that one of the major challenges which arise from the casting of well-known Bollywood actors in mythological roles is the issue of having images which the followers know about. The other thing which he mentioned was the difficulty of disassociating the star from previous performance works which he or she may have done. Moreover, he shared that the image of a star will not be able to translate into the story of mythology.

title: Janhvi Kapoor seeks ban over deepfakes and obscene content; Delhi High Court questions blanket action against fan pages
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Court indicates protection against pornographic material and commercial misuse while questioning the strict action to be taken pages which promote the star.

Adding to this, However, the court questioned whether such protection could extend indiscriminately to all fan pages and social media accounts associated with the star. Justice Bhambhani stressed the importance of finding a balance between safeguarding a star’s personality rights and protecting legitimate criticism, satire and freedom of expression.

Meanwhile, Kapoor’s lawyer, Advocate Asav Rajan, told the court that the star was particularly aggrieved by pornographic content, fake profiles impersonating her and AI-generated images and deepfakes. He also alleged that accounts on Meta-owned platforms and X were being used to circulate misleading information in her name.

Notably, According to the arguments presented in court, Kapoor is seeking restrictions on third-party commercial exploitation of her name, image and other elements associated with her persona. Her counsel also flagged fan pages that allegedly combine commercial use of her personality traits with obscene or profane content.

As per the latest buzz, The court indicated that protection could broadly cover three categories including material that is clearly pornographic or obscene, content that directly seeks to commercially monetise Kapoor’s personality rights, and the use of her name or likeness for selling merchandise or promoting services.

In further updates, At the same time, Justice Bhambhani questioned whether every fan page could be treated as an infringement, pointing out that some pages could merely be satirical or critical of an star’s work. The judge observed that commercial exploitation could justify intervention, but a blanket restriction on fan clubs would not necessarily be appropriate.

On top of that, Kapoor’s counsel as per reports submitted more than 4,000 URLs containing the disputed material. Representing Meta platforms, Advocate Varun Pathak argued that the URLs did not all contain material that could uniformly be classified as obscene or profane. He agreed that clearly objectionable content could be removed but sought narrower categories for the broader request.

The court has therefore asked Kapoor’s legal team to classify the material into appropriate categories before deciding on the scope of the order. Justice Bhambhani also cautioned against an overly broad interpretation of personality rights, noting that such claims should not become a means of suppressing legitimate expression or shielding alleged wrongdoing.

title: Amit Shah writes to Speaker Om Birla, says govt ready to discuss student protest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Union home minister Amit Shah wrote to Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla, saying the government is ready to discuss the student protest, urging him to consult with the Opposition on when they want the discussion and to allocate as much time as he deems appropriate.

Adding to this, Union home minister Amit Shah. (ANI) Shah cited parliamentary affairs minister Kiren Rijiju’s statement at the Business Advisory Committee meeting that the government was ready for a discussion in Parliament on the student agitation and the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Undergraduate) or NEET (UG) paper leak.

Meanwhile, “I would also like to mention that earlier, at the request of the Opposition, a discussion took place in the current session of Parliament on the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026, in which no honourable Member of Parliament from the Opposition expressed any views in the House regarding the NEET examination. Despite this, the government is ready to discuss this issue again,” he shared in the letter written in Hindi.

Notably, Shah shared he wants to be in the House for the discussion and is ready to answer all questions of the Opposition. “Solutions emerge only through discussion and dialogue in a democracy. I have unwavering faith in democracy and democratic institutions, and I believe this House is meant precisely for discussion and dialogue...,” he wrote.

As per the latest buzz, Earlier in the day, Shah shared the government is ready for a discussion on the student protests as well as the subsequent police action, provided the Opposition allows the House to run. He maintained that he has been coming regularly to Parliament amid demands for his presence and a statement in the House on the issue.

In further updates, In a rare statement to journalists outside Parliament, Shah shared the Opposition does not want the discussion. He added that the Opposition should submit a letter to the Speaker by 2pm to begin the debate from 3pm (Wednesday).

On top of that, Parliament’s ongoing monsoon session has largely been washed out over the past two weeks. The Opposition has insisted on Shah’s statement in the House over allegations of police excesses and the use of pellet guns during the July 20 protest march, demanding then Union education minister Dharmendra Pradhan’s resignation.

title: Karnataka bandh: Will schools be open tomorrow during shutdown over Cauvery water-sharing row?
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
As the Cauvery water-sharing row between Tamil Nadu and Karnataka intensifies, several Kanada organisations have given a call for a Karnataka Bandh on Thursday, August 13.

Adding to this, Several Kanada organisations have backed the bandh call for August 13. (Photo for representation) (HT Photos) The bandh comes after the Cauvery Water Management Authority (CWMA) directed Karnataka to rollout 12,000 cusecs of water daily to Tamil Nadu for 15 days from August 12.
Meanwhile, "We will observe Bandh at any cost. I appeal to everyone to support our call for strike," Vatal Nagaraj, convener of Kannada Chalavali Vatal Paksha was quoted as saying by news agency PTI.

Notably, The Mandya District Farmers' Welfare Protection Committee also revealed a protest near the Visvesvaraya statue in Mandya on Wednesday as it urged the farmers, Kannada organisations, workers, women and citizens to participate in the demonstrations.

As per the latest buzz, "The government should not rollout water under any circumstances," a farmer leader was quoted as saying as he called the CWMA direction a threat to the Karnataka's water security.

In further updates, Yes, the schools will operate per normal on August 13 during Karnataka Bandh, The News Minute reported, citing Karnataka Associated Managements of Schools (KAMS). The body had earlier called for the closure of schools, but later rolled back the call, saying that it would impact the academic schedules.

On top of that, However, the KAMS has shared it would extend moral support to the bandh. School managements, teaching staff and non-teaching employees have been asked to wear black ribbons or black strips as a mark of solidarity, the report added.
Banks, hospitals, pharmacies and public transport and other essential services are likely to remain unaffected during the statewide bandh that will remain in effective from 6 am to 6 pm on August 13.

title: BREAKING: Chetan Hansraj plays SEVEN characters in Ramayana, including Ravana’s maternal grandfather
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In an interview with Hindustan Times, the 54-year-old star verified that in Ramayana , he plays the role of Raja Mali, the maternal grandfather of Ravana (Yash). Chetan Hansraj told Hindustan Times, “Raja Mali is an important character that went down in history, and my scenes with Yash are pure fire. He is such a delight on screen, and these two characters complement each other wonderfully. It was huge for me.”
Adding to this, He then revealed, “After my part was wrapped, I was offered six motion-capture characters, including one of Ravana’s brothers and a demon.”

Meanwhile, Chetan Hansraj also opened up on the criticism of the movie and comparisons with Ramanand Sagar’s iconic TV series, Ramayan. He shared, “We have the best action directors from Hollywood and Bollywood, and technicians on board, like Terry Notary... Makers today want to give the best cinematic experience, and that’s a vision we should understand. People who once see it on the right medium will forget all these comparisons, I am sure.”

Notably, Besides Chetan Hansraj, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. It is directed by Nitesh Tiwari of Dangal (2016) fame and produced by Namit Malhotra. The music is composed by A R Rahman and Hans Zimmer. It's a two-part saga with the first part releasing on Diwali 2026. As for the second part, it'll arrive on the big screen on Diwali 2027. Interestingly, while the first part will rollout in India on November 8, it will arrive in international markets two days earlier, on November 6.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, Mumbai, Salman Khan shared he really enjoyed working on "7 Dogs", an international action spectacle featuring talent from India, Egypt, Europe, Hollywood and the Middle East, as the movie gave him a chance to be part of a collaboration spanning different cultures and movie industries.

Adding to this, Salman Khan says '7 Dogs' is truly international: 'A big screen movie in every sense' Salman features in the movie, which will rollout in Hindi and English across Indian cinemas on August 21, along with Sanjay Dutt as well as Egyptian superstars Ahmed Ezz and Karim Abdel Aziz, and international actors Monica Bellucci and Giancarlo Esposito.

title: Ranbir Kapoor calls out ‘CGI critics’ for criticising Ramayana’s VFX while watching trailer on phone: ‘It’s quite funny’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Nitesh Tiwari ’s Ramayana is among the most-awaited films of the year. The movie’s trailer, rolled out on July 30, quickly became a talking point, with viewers divided over its visuals and VFX. While some lauded the scale of the project, others criticised its CGI. Now, in an interview with Collider, star Ranbir Kapoor has addressed the criticism and spoken about what he called the rise of “CG critics”.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor in a still from the Ramayana English trailer. Ranbir Kapoor on Ramayana's VFX, CGI criticism Ranbir shared that viewers have become increasingly interested in the quality of CGI, particularly with the growing use of AI. “There has been a phenomenon right now. In the last few years, there are such a large number of people who have become these CG critics. They see the trailer, and they are always critiquing that it’s not good enough or it’s seemingly not done. So I think people are getting more aware, especially with the influx of AI. People are getting more interested in how good the CGI is and how good the CGI will finally look once the movie releases,” he shared.

Meanwhile, He added, “I think it’s quite funny sometimes because people who know how CG is done think like someone’s just used some AI and rolled out something. You know, there are countless hours of work where artists are working for years. I have seen Nitesh sir and Namit sitting on VFX calls ever since this project started, trying to get even a certain colour of the sky right. I think it’s tricky right now trying to impress the audience with authentic CGI.”

Notably, The movie’s producer, Namit Malhotra, also addressed the criticism, arguing that much of it stems from viewers watching the trailer on phones rather than experiencing it in IMAX 3D. Calling the criticism “noise”, he shared the team has been encouraging creators and influencers to assess the visuals in the format they were designed for. He cited Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey as an example of a movie best experienced on a large-format IMAX screen, adding that judging visual and sound quality on a phone does not provide an accurate representation of the intended experience.

As per the latest buzz, Helmed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by Namit Malhotra, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, Yash as Ravana and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The movie also features Arun Govil, Vivek Oberoi, Rakul Preet Singh and Lara Dutta in key roles.

In further updates, Mounted on a reported budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees, the movie will be rolled out in two parts. The first part is scheduled to rollout during Diwali 2026, followed by the second part during Diwali 2027.

title: Batwara 1947's distributor softens stand, agrees to 50-50 shows with Awarapan 2; Spider-Man’s ‘MINIMUM 2 shows in single-screens’ demand leaves exhibitors worried
body: Here's the latest update from the Hollywood/Marvel world:

An exhibition source told Bollywood Hungama , “Earlier, their requirement was that 60% to 70% of the shows should be allotted to Batwara 1947 . However, they have now taken note of the exhibitors’ concerns. As a result, they have agreed to a 50-50 showcasing arrangement for both films.”

Adding to this, As per some exhibitors, the 50-50 arrangement will also apply to single-screen cinemas. However, most single-screen theatres across the country are yet to open bookings. One of the rare exceptions is the iconic Raj Mandir Cinema in Jaipur, which has allotted two shows each to Awarapan 2 and Batwara 1947 .

Meanwhile, But even as one issue appears to have been resolved, exhibitors are now faced with another challenge. On Tuesday, the distributors of Spider-Man: Brand New Day sent an email to cinemas, asking them to continue playing the movie with a substantial number of shows.

Notably, A trade source revealed, “In single-screen cinemas, they have asked for a minimum of two shows a day, while in two-screen theatres, the requirement is at least three shows daily. In three-screen cinemas, they have asked exhibitors to allot one full screen, comprising five shows a day, to Spider-Man: Brand New Day . In four-screen properties, the demand is for seven to eight shows, including at least one evening and one night show. In five-screen cinemas, they have asked for nine shows, while properties with six screens or more have been asked to allot 11 to 12 shows. They have also specified that at least two screens should be allotted to the movie in six-screen plexes.”

As per the latest buzz, The source further shared, “Sony’s directive has once again left exhibitors anxious as they are unsure how to divide the shows between the three films. Of course, Sony feels justified in making these demands as Spider-Man: Brand New Day continues to remain rock-solid at the ticket-window. It collected around Rs. 9 crores on Tuesday, and it is clear that the movie will continue to perform strongly over the Independence Day weekend. But for exhibitors, the challenge will be to divide the available shows in a way that satisfies all three distributors.”

In further updates, An exhibitor from Nawalgarh, Rajasthan, speaking on the condition of anonymity, sighed, “We always face this problem of doing ‘ batwara ’ of shows while making sure that none of the distributors is upset with us. We just wonder when this ‘ awarapan ’ will end.”

title: Divyenndu says killing Munna Bhaiya was a mistake, reflects on comeback in Mirzapur: The Movie: ‘I am immortal’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Having dominated the world of streaming for many years now, Mirzapur is finally coming to theaters. Mirzapur: The Movie will bring back certain characters who were thought to be long dead but that has added to the excitement of followers. One of those characters has been star Divyenndu’s popular character Munna Bhaiya. The trailer of the movie was launched on August 11 in Mumbai in the presence of the entire cast.

Adding to this, Divyenndu jokes about his ‘immortal’ return as Munna Bhaiya as Mirzapur heads to theatres. Divyenndu jokes about Munna Bhaiya’s comeback One of the biggest talking points of the movie is the return of Divyenndu as Munna Bhaiya. When asked about the comeback of his character, he shared in his character's trademark style, “To begin with, it was a mistake, and everyone agrees. I am a Hindi movie hero; I am immortal; nothing can happen to me.”

Meanwhile, For unversed, d uring the final episode of season 2, Munna Tripathi found himself in a fight with Guddu Pandit and Golu Gupta. He got shot several times by Golu, and thus he ended up dying. His body was later taken away by Guddu and Golu.

Notably, Crediting the audience for Mirzapur's popularity and turning a dream into reality, producer Farhan Akhtar shared, “The viewers of this show, it is because of their love that this has happened. They have supported the show from the time it was first rolled out. Amazon took it across the world. People do ask about different films and sequels, but wherever I go, they always ask me when Mirzapur is coming. They always ask about this. Ever since this movie was revealed, people have been asking when it will be rolled out. So, it is the followers who have demanded this movie. We are very happy and grateful to have put it together with the original cast and the amazing new cast.”

As per the latest buzz, Talking about a fun memory with writer Puneet Krishna, Farhan added, “When Puneet first came to us, our first instinct was to take him to a psychiatrist, but then we thought if we made the show, people could get into it. Guru and Puneet are the heroes of the show.”

In further updates, The makers rolled out the trailer of Mirzapur: The Movie, which continues from the world of Season 1. Some of the popular characters like Kaleen Bhaiya, Munna Bhaiya and Guddu Pandit are returning. Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, Divyendu, and Rasika Dugal are all returning. The character of Bablu Pandit, originally played by Vikrant Massey in the series, will be portrayed by Jitendra Kumar in the movie.

On top of that, Harshita Gaur, Sheeba Chaddha, Abhishek Banerjee and Rajesh Tailang are also returning with some new faces Sonal Chauhan, Ravi Kishan, Sushant Singh, and Mohit Malik. The movie releases in theatres on September 4.

title: Haiwaan teaser: Blind Saif Ali Khan hunts ‘monster’ Akshay Kumar; Priyadarshan reminds Bollywood what ‘teaser’ means
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The teaser of Haiwaan, Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan’s reunion, was unveiled on Wednesday, and it seems to have a message for the movie industry. After years of watching 2-minute-long ‘teasers’ that almost give the plot away, the psychological thriller finally holds its cards close to its chest, but not in an annoying manner. Haiwaan teaser does what it is supposed to: tease the audience while heightening intrigue, without even revealing what the movie is about.

Adding to this, Haiwaan teaser: A shot of Akshay Kumar from the movie. Haiwaan teaser is chilling The short, 45-second teaser begins with a silhouette of Saif as eerie music plays. The crescendo then builds up as a silhouette of a sinister-looking Akshay is revealed. We learn that Saif is visually impaired, as he walks with a walking stick and wears a special watch for the blind. A bloody hand hints at something violent afoot. A clip shows Akshay’s character walking menacingly before we hear his sinister laugh.

Meanwhile, The teaser does not reveal the two actors’ faces, nor does it include any shots of any other characters from the movie or details about the plot. But it can be implied that the titular haiwaan may be played by Akshay, with a blind Saif trying to hunt him down. Keeping its biggest cards firmly under wraps, the teaser leaves audiences guessing about what lies beneath the surface.

Notably, Followers were all in for Haiwaan after the intriguing introduction to this dark world. Director Priyadarshan collected some praise for how the teaser has been cut, as did the two actors. “Priyadarshan + Akshay Kumar = Smash hit,” wrote one. Many followers particularly lauded Akshay’s return to what appears to be a negative space. “Ajnabi, Robot 2.0 and now Haiwaan. Finally AK Paaji back in villainous mode,” read one comment. Another person wrote, “No dialogue fir bhi goosebumps. Akshay kumar villain mode on.” Some, however, felt this was too little. “At least they should have given the first look at characters,” complained one.

As per the latest buzz, Adding to its powerful lead pairing, Haiwaan also features an ensemble cast including Boman Irani, Saiyami Kher and Shriya Pilgaonkar in pivotal roles. Haiwaan is produced under KVN Productions and Thespian Films by Venkat K. Narayana and Shailaja Desai Fenn. The movie releases theatrically on 11 September 2026.

Ahaan Panday dances with Vedika Pinto In the clip, which is going widely shared on social media, Ahaan and Vedika can be seen dancing to Lata Mangeshkar’s iconic song Ajeeb Dastan Hai Yeh from the 1959 movie Dil Apna Aur Preet Parai, with lyrics by Shailendra. The two are seen performing a romantic dance as the crowd cheers them on. While Vedika is dressed in a golden lehenga, Ahaan looks dapper in a black formal suit.

Meanwhile, Followers were quick to react to the video, with many praising the duo’s chemistry. One fan wrote, “Can picture them in a potential rom-com.” Another gushed, “This is such a beautiful genuine picture. Oh, they have chemistry! Haven’t seen great chemistry in the new lot.” A third commented, “They look better than him with Aneet.” Another wrote, “Ngl, both look great together.” One more comment read, “The chemistry is through the roof.”

Notably, While Ahaan made his Bollywood debut in 2025 with Saiyaara, Vedika entered the industry earlier with the romantic thriller Operation Romeo. She later featured in Gumraah alongside Aditya Roy Kapur and Mrunal Thakur. Her role in Nishaanchi further brought her recognition, and she is now being seen in the Netflix series Musafir Cafe.

As per the latest buzz, In the show, Vedika essays the role of Sudha, a strong and independent divorce lawyer whose outlook on relationships and commitment differs from that of Chander (Vikrant Massey). Their relationship becomes central to the story as circumstances pull them apart and bring them back into each other’s lives. The show also stars Mahima Makwana, Adil Hussain and Saita Siddiqui in key roles.

The conversations about the show have hijacked the Internet with debates about the ending and what lies ahead, the dialogues, the characters and the music. Romance as a genre, when done right, captures hearts and conversations as no other genre does. We are bullish about building this genre, like we built comedy for our members. And I’m happy to announce Musafir Cafe Season 2 will be an integral part of that slate. We can’t wait to take this tale of love and longing into its next exciting phase.”

On top of that, Ahaan, meanwhile, will next be seen in Ali Abbas Zafar’s romantic action drama. The yet-untitled movie also stars Sharvari, Bobby Deol and Aaishwary Thackeray in key roles. Backed by Aditya Chopra, the movie is scheduled to rollout in March 2027.

title: Janhvi Kapoor gets relief from obscene content, but Delhi HC refuses blanket ban on fanpages: ‘How can you shut down?’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Delhi High Court has ordered the removal of any obscene or pornographic materials that exist on the internet regarding star Janhvi Kapoor , but fell short of giving a blanket injunction against any fan pages and other unauthorised material. Court held that personal rights cannot be construed in such a way that they act to curb freedom of speech, especially regarding celebrities.

Adding to this, Janhvi Kapoor gets protection from pornographic content as Delhi HC questions personality rights. (PTI) Court limits relief to obscene content According to Bar and Bench report, Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani was hearing the case filed by Janhvi to seek the protection of her personality rights from any unauthorised use for commercial purposes. The star had asked for an order against over 5,000 webpages and posts on various social media platforms where her image was being used for commercial gains.

Meanwhile, While the court did agree that Kapoor was eligible for protection from such obviously offensive content, it wanted the lawyers of the plaintiff to be more selective regarding the content on which they are seeking immediate relief. For this purpose, the court told them to create a precise tabular format listing all those webpages which have such obviously pornographic, obscene or lascivious material.

Notably, However, the Court did not agree to the demand for removing fan pages because the Court realised that fan sites can have many variations; some may praise the work of an star while others may criticize it. Justice Bhambhani shared that this form of expression falls within the ambit of freedom that people enjoy on the Internet. “We are not the conscience keepers of the nation. Solution may be worse than the problem. It was at the very root of free speech,” Justice Bhambhani observed, adding “Fan pages may be lampooning, adulatory of your work, critical of your work. You don't want followers? It is the digital world. No comments, no URLs...You will find yourself living in a cave.”

As per the latest buzz, The Court further questioned how a public personality could seek to shut down every fan club or unofficial page using their name. “They should just be genuflecting in front of you? Stand and touch my feet? How can you shut down all fan clubs? You are a public personality. Who is immune these days? Everyone who is in public domain is being abused left, right and centre.”

In further updates, In the process of hearing the case, the Justice went through the line dividing copyright and personality rights. He questioned whether selling a photograph or a piece of art that depicts a star automatically means the creator is unfairly profiting off that person's identity.

On top of that, On this matter, the court held that an individual who creates a photograph has the right to sell it and wondered how it can be an exploitation of the personality of the subject. It is like an author who has the right to sell the book he wrote.

For instance, the judge used a hypothetical situation in which there was an artwork made out of the picture of Janhvi. The court wanted to know what would happen if the pottery makes a mug, puts the picture of Janhvi on it, and sells it. In that case, the owner of the copyrights of that visual material is the person who created it or took a photograph of it.
